en: We will rejoice and sing our song of victory
Gathering in love the oppressed the poor and lame Giving them praise and renown in the earth
we will rejoice with all our heart A mighty king is our midst

ko: 기뻐 외치며 주께 두 손 들리
en: We'll shout for joy, we'll lift our hands to Him
We'll dance and sing to the King of kings
He has cleared away all our enemies
The mighty God is in our midst
